2607.28587.title: PAIChecker: Uncovering and Checking PR-Issue Misalignment in SWE-Bench-Like Benchmarks
2607.28587.paper_summary: SWE-bench-like benchmarks are widely used for evaluating LLM's issue resolution capability. They typically follow a common construction pipeline: each PR (Pull Request) is paired with its linked issue by extracting issue references from the PR description; the issue description is used as the problem statement, and the PR patch serves as the test oracle. However, due to the inherent complexity of developing and maintaining large repositories, such PR-Issue pairings are often misaligned in practice. In this work, we systematically study SWE-bench Verified instances, finding that 13.6% exhibit misalignment across five patterns in eleven fine-grained scenarios. To enable reliable and scalable construction of those benchmarks in the future, we propose PAIChecker, a multi-agent system for checking PR-Issue misalignment in SWE-bench-like benchmarks. Specifically, PAIChecker adopts a three-phase design that combines specific pattern identification, cross-agent label synthesis, and code-level validation, thereby enabling more accurate, generalizable, and progressively verified detection. Experiments on SWE-Gym and SWE-bench Multilingual show that PAIchecker achieves the best performance across all four LLM backbones, reaching up to 92.12% and 91.67% binary accuracy, respectively.
2607.28587.paper_summary_zh: SWE-bench-like 基準廣泛用於評估 LLM 的問題解決能力。<lb/>它們通常遵循一個共同的構建流程：每個 PR（Pull Request）通過從 PR 描述中提取問題參考來與其相關的問題配對；問題描述用作問題陳述，而 PR 補丁則作為測試預言。<lb/>然而，由於開發和維護大型庫的內在複雜性，這種 PR-問題配對在實踐中往往不一致。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們系統地研究了 SWE-bench Verified 實例，發現 13.6% 在十一個細粒度場景中展現出五種模式的不一致性。<lb/>為了在未來可靠且可擴展地構建這些基準，我們提出了 PAIChecker，一個用於檢查 SWE-bench-like 基準中 PR-問題不一致的多代理系統。<lb/>具體而言，PAIChecker 採用三階段設計，結合特定模式識別、跨代理標籤合成和代碼級驗證，從而實現更準確、可泛化和逐步驗證的檢測。<lb/>在 SWE-Gym 和 SWE-bench Multilingual 上的實驗顯示，PAIchecker 在所有四個 LLM 基礎上達到了最佳性能，分別達到 92.12% 和 91.67% 的二元準確率。
